## How to get it

1. Download **KalciCam-x86_64.AppImage** (below, under "Assets").
2. Right-click the file, open **Properties**, and turn on **"Allow executing file as program"**.
3. Double-click it.

The first time, a setup helper opens and gets everything ready for you.

## Already have an older version?

Delete the old file and use this one. Your settings stay the same.

## Something not working?

Open a terminal and run this, then send the text it shows to whoever gave you KalciCam:

```
./KalciCam-x86_64.AppImage --selftest
```
